artifact_types: local project context or learning records
search, restore, prune, or reconciliation result
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Context storage is opt-in per record and project; secrets, unrelated sessions, unverified claims, indefinite retention, cross-machine sync, and external services are blocked under this local-only identity.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Project identity, context artifacts, privacy boundary, retention, synchronization mode, and local-system write authorization when persistence is requested.
outputs: local project context or learning records
search, restore, prune, or reconciliation result
responsibility: Restore, search, prune, or reconcile records inside one project-isolated local context store under privacy, retention, provenance, and deletion controls; writes of new records route to local-learning-persistence.
